newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance powers Delhi shares to a stronger close. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Reliance powers Delhi shares to a stronger close. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: Buyers flocked to Reliance Industries after it announced a one-for-one bonus share issue on Thursday, driving Delhi share prices to a higher close.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index closed 5.49 points higher at 871.72.
Petrochemicals giant Reliance Industries ended weeks of feverish guessing, announcing a one-for-one bonus share issue at a packed annual shareholders meeting in Bombay.
Reliance closed 11 (corrects from 12.55) rupees higher at 376.45 (corrects from 388.00).

"The market was expecting good outcome of today's annual general meeting but news of one-for-one is much above the expectations of general investors and brokers," said Suresh Aggarwal of brokers Jai Mata Securities.
"The market remained busy selling other shares to buy in Reliance," Aggarwal added.

Traders said the bonus issue was more generous than the market had expected. The market had expected the company to announce an issue of three shares for every five shares held -- the same ratio as Reliance's last two bonus issues.
